Praveen Achuthan Kutty has been paid deferral portion of variable pay for FY 2021-22, FY 2022-23, FY 2023-24 and FY 2024-25 of `1.44 crores in FY2025-26.
Krishnan Sridhar Seshadri has been paid deferral portion of variable pay for FY 2021-2022, FY 2022-2023, FY 2023-2024 and FY 2024-2025 of ` 55.5 Lakhs in FY 2025-26.
Growth & demand: Policy initiatives such as the expansion of TReDS, enhanced credit guarantee coverage, the ₹10,000 crore SME Growth Fund, and increased allocation to the SRI Fund are aimed at strengthening financing access and supporting the long-term growth of the MSME ecosystem.

Expanding Credit- Deposit Divergence India's banking sector continued to record strong balance sheet growth during FY 2025-26, with deposits increasing 13.5% and credit growth accelerating to 15.9% year-on-year, supported by robust demand across industry and services segments.
